_doc: Hand-entered counts and race calls for election night. Keys are race ids from senate-polls-2026.json (e.g. ME, OH-special). Anything here wins over the automatic feed for that race; remove the entry when the feed is right. Fields: as_of (ISO time), source, source_url, reporting (free text), reporting_pct, called_for (D, R or I), candidates [{name, party, votes}]. Votes must be totals, not percentages. Edit on GitHub, commit, and the next scheduled run (or Actions → Live results → Run workflow) publishes it.
